name: investflow
description: Open-source skills framework, CLI, MCP, and research methodology for investment agents.

interface.shortDescription: Investment research workflow tools for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: InvestFlow helps investment agents clarify context, build research plans, construct theses, check valuation, review risks, audit evidence, and produce auditable research outputs without presenting standalone trading commands.
defaultPrompt: Use InvestFlow to brief this investment question.
Review this thesis with InvestFlow risk checks.
Run an InvestFlow postmortem on this trade.
